heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text2: Quick answers to the questions we hear most about this service.

items.question: Which framework do you recommend?
items.answer: It depends on your product. We review your needs and explain the trade-offs before choosing.

items.question: Will the app feel native?
items.answer: Yes. We follow each platform’s design conventions and use native modules where needed.

items.question: Can one app also run on the web?
items.answer: Some frameworks support web output. We advise on whether it suits your product.

items.question: How long does cross platform app development take?
items.answer: A focused app usually takes 8 to 12 weeks, while feature-rich apps with custom backends take 4 to 8 months.

items.question: Do you offer support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We provide maintenance, updates, monitoring and new feature development after launch.
